title: Images with Coil, and the memory a list of photos eats

videos.script: Each course in the planner gets a cover picture today. One line of Compose shows it. The rest of the lesson is what that line is doing for you. {{async}} First, AsyncImage. It downloads, decodes, caches, and shows something while it waits. {{memory}} Then the number that surprises everybody. A picture file of fifty-three kilobytes becomes forty-eight megabytes in memory. Asked for at the size of the card, the same picture is under one megabyte. {{caches}} Then the two caches, in memory and on disk. Four loads of one cover, and the server is asked once. {{states}} Then the three states that are not the picture: loading, failed, and no picture at all. You will see all four side by side. {{lists}} And last, a list of forty covers. Sized, they fit in the cache. At full size, not one does.
